data.title: 焰影苇草 · 新长出的叶子
data.description: 她蹲在花盆旁，发现一片新叶正舒展开来，便把遮住它的落叶轻轻移开。
data.promptProse: Kneeling on the brick path of a country greenhouse, Reed gently brushes away a stray fallen leaf from a terracotta pot to reveal a tender green sprout. A small copper watering can and garden spade rest on the moist earth beneath sparkling morning dew.
data.animaCaption: Crouching beside the flowerpot, she shields the fragile new shoot with one cupped hand, admiring its green leaves in the morning light.
